name: VERITAS — Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory
notes: Telescope positions are OpenStreetMap nodes (telescopes T1-T4, source=yahoo, edited 2026-10-08), read with the OSM API map call on 2026-10-25 because Overpass answered 502 at capacity. Their spacings agree with the labels of Figure 1 of Perkins and Maier 2009 to within 7 % (four of five labels within 4 %), and T1 is at its post-2009 position.
Buildings of the basecamp (the OSM polygons of the administrative complex and car parks) are unnamed and are not drawn; no fetched source identifies them.

Distance T1-T4 (172 m in OSM) is not in any fetched text; Figure 4 of the 2025 VERITAS overview (arXiv:2507.09813; y axis north) shows T1 about 170 m east of T4 by eye, consistent with OSM, but a figure read by eye is not cited as a source.

summary.plain: The VERITAS array of four 12 m gamma-ray telescopes at the basecamp of the Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory on Mount Hopkins, Arizona, with the basecamp outline.
summary.technical: Four telescope points from OpenStreetMap nodes, each checked by centroid-to-centroid distance against the spacings labelled in Figure 1 of Perkins and Maier 2009 (7 % tolerance); the array outline is the quadrilateral through them with a perimeter check of 409 m (sum of the four labelled sides). Map centre is the collaboration's published array coordinate (31d40'30.21"N, 110d57'7.77"W), 24 m from the OSM quadrilateral's centroid.
